fixture.construction: Roots use legal seeded setup and completed turns, followed by explicit card/resource inventories with balanced bank counts. Road Building holds one old and one newly bought card; Knight begins with two played knights; a forced seven queues two off-turn discarders. All emitted stages execute real upstream actions, with multiple legal choices at every encoder boundary.
fixture.scope: Compound-stage perfect-information observation parity, not full rules equivalence, numeric network parity, training provenance, or playing strength. Native Swift roots are reconstructed from raw fields; UpstreamPolicy supplies every private staged state and context. Only predictor logits are prescribed.
